# Press summary of the adjusted study (fixture, near-duplicate)

> **FIXTURE — not a real source.** Written for the test suite. The numbers illustrate a structure; they are not evidence about the world.

In a summary of our study we restate the central result. Unadjusted group differences in
registered offending are substantial; after adjustment for age, sex, socioeconomic status
and urbanisation they shrink substantially and for several groups largely disappear. The
summary repeats the estimate ranges and points readers to the full report for the
offence-specific results.
